WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2;

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 ORDER BY 2

SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids,
  min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'

SELECT count(*) AS returns, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_sales_lines
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'

SELECT o.status, (o.web_order_id IS NULL) AS no_order_row, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
 min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'
GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31' GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales) AS rpt_net, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_before, sum(r.returns_net) AS rpt_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
